usage: agentware fanout [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    spin-up       provision N isolated lanes (package + KB worktrees + env
                  file)
    list          report each active lane's branch, KB path, and loop outcome
    merge-policy  install the idempotent merge=union .gitattributes in the KB
                  repo
    merge-queue   serially integrate finished lanes onto an integration branch
                  (gated)
    teardown      remove merged lanes' worktrees + branches (refuses
                  unmerged/dirty)

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
